description: This Perl module defines a class Git::SVN::Memoize::YAML that allows a hash to be tied to a YAML file, enabling memoization cache persistence in YAML format. It includes methods for tying, storing, fetching, checking existence, and destruction, with documentation for usage and dependencies.

classes.name: Git::SVN::Memoize::YAML
classes.description: A Perl class that ties a hash to a YAML file for persistent memoization caching.

methods.name: TIEHASH
methods.description: Constructor to tie a hash to a YAML file, loading data if file exists.

methods.name: STORE
methods.description: Stores a key-value pair into the tied hash.

methods.name: FETCH
methods.description: Fetches a value associated with a key from the tied hash.

methods.name: EXISTS
methods.description: Checks if a key exists in the hash.

methods.name: DESTROY
methods.description: Dumps the hash to the YAML file during object destruction.

methods.name: SCALAR
methods.description: Returns the number of key-value pairs in the hash.

methods.name: FIRSTKEY
methods.description: Returns a placeholder string since the hash is fake.

methods.name: NEXTKEY
methods.description: Returns undef, as iteration is not implemented.
